selection_policy: Latest saved final B-0003 run per model configuration, qualified_v1, 40 counted actions, all ten active subjects; exclude infrastructure-failed trials. Includes unranked Muse run.
subject_averaging: Average trials within each model and subject, then give each model equal weight.
overall_subject_average: Give each subject equal weight after model averaging.
overall_game_average: Pool actual ASK counts from all included scored games.
source_validation: PublishedDataset validation and ASK-turn recount for the 11 published runs; native integrity-verified BenchmarkResult validation and ASK-turn recount for Muse.

excluded_comparable_runs.reason: Superseded by a newer run of the same model configuration
